questions.stem: Sample 2001: 10.34 mL of 0.0589 M KMnO4 oxidizes Fe2+ in a 5 to 1 ratio. What volume of 0.202 M Fe2+ solution reacts?

options.misconception: applies the stoichiometric factor in the wrong direction
reports millimoles of permanganate as a volume of iron solution
ignores the five-to-one stoichiometry and assumes a one-to-one ratio

questions.explanation: The balanced reaction consumes five moles of iron(II) per mole of permanganate. Converting permanganate volume and molarity to moles, multiplying by five, and dividing by the iron molarity gives the iron solution volume. Dropping or inverting the factor breaks the stoichiometry.
questions.hint: Five Fe2+ react with each MnO4−.
